description: vibeproof Codex hooks; merge explicitly, then review host trust.

hooks.command: D=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$D" ]; then V4_HOST=codex exec python3 "$D/hooks/write_block.py"; else echo "v4 write_block: no git root; hook did not run" >&2; echo '{}'; fi
